rows.coder_note: Step 4 of the decision order (rules D, I1, E, C5). The row's own passage (abstract) gives the name FinnGen alone. The sentence at outcome_2:p002 that refers to this dataset (rule I2) gives 6847 cases and 314,193 controls, which equal no FinnGen row's N, the endpoint code C3_COLORECTAL_EXALLC, which names a phenotype and no release, and reference 26 (Kurki 2023, doi:10.1038/s41586-022-05473-8), which is the source of all ten FinnGen rows R3 to R12 with no separating attribute, so rule C5 does not give a code. Rule C2 does not apply: the outcome side has FinnGen rows. Accession, rule C4: the endpoint code is not a repository accession of a release and none of the three cases is applied to it.

rows.quote: Genetic data associated with CRC were obtained from the IEU OpenGWAS project(https://gwas.mrcieu.ac.uk/)database (19,948 cases and 12,124 controls; dataset number: ebi-a-GCST012879) and FinnGen (https://www.finngen.fi/fi) [26] database (6847 cases and 314,193 controls; dataset number: C3_COLORECTAL_EXALLC).
rows.coder_note: Step 3 of the decision order (rules B, G, C4). Accession, rule C4 third case: ebi-a-GCST012879 is listed by no dictionary row by prefix (only ukb-b and ukb-d are listed), range (GCST90018563-GCST90019002 does not contain it) or identifier, and the sentence attributes it to no citation, so rule C5 does not apply; the counts 19,948 cases and 12,124 controls equal no row's.
